feeding_claim.verbatim: Truly grass-fed grass/finished beef. No antibiotics, hormones, or grain.

notes: Verifier 2026-11-22: read grass-fed beef store page, store index, about page and the cattle blog post. resold_note: Store says products come from family farms like ours and other trusted local farms without naming them, and also sells pastured chicken, lamb and produce whose source is not stated.
